note: GDP per capita is measured in [international-$](#dod:int_dollar_abbreviation) at 2021 prices to account for inflation and differences in living costs between countries. The share of adults who use tobacco is [age-standardized](#dod:age_standardized).
title: Share of adults who smoke or use other tobacco vs. GDP per capita
subtitle: Estimated percentage of people aged 15 and older who currently use tobacco. This includes all forms of tobacco use, such as smoking, chewing or snuffing, but excludes products that do not contain tobacco, such as e-cigarettes.

display.name: Share of people who use tobacco
